snippet.title: Just Dance Now Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Just Dance Now is available for download in the App Store and Google Play! 
www.JustDanceNow.com 

App Store: http://bit.ly/1n9rYrY
Google Play: http://bit.ly/1t22FVh

Play anywhere, anytime, and with unlimited number of players. The Just Dance Now mobile app turns your mobile device into a remote for a second screen experience featuring select tracks form our back catalogue. 

Visit our Website! http://www.JustDanceGame.com 
Join us on Facebook! http://www.facebook.com/JustDanceGame
Follow us on Twitter! http://www.twitter.com/JustDanceGame
Follow us on Instagram! http://instagram.com/justdancegame
Add us on Snapchat! Username: JustDance
